title: NetSuRF M9.3 task-generic measurements
compatibility: Extends v3.3. Existing v3.0-v3.3 readers and finalized bundles remain unchanged.

task_metric_contract.primary_metric: Explicit task-level metric name, direction, and value; classification accuracy or anomaly ROC-AUC.
task_metric_contract.loss_metric: Explicit ranking/evaluation loss name, direction, and value; categorical cross-entropy or reconstruction MSE.
task_metric_contract.prohibition: Anomaly ROC-AUC and reconstruction MSE must not be serialized under accuracy or categorical_crossentropy labels.

protection_results.csv.semantics: Task-named pooled primary and loss summaries across every saved replication and matched fault trial.

replication_protection_results.csv.semantics: Within-replication task-named summaries kept separate from pooled fault-realization variation.

paired_comparisons.csv.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within logical BER and metric family
